paite: Huan TOUPA'N Samuel kiang Huansraelite kummipang ka deih louhsa Saul ziak in bang tan ahia na lungkham ding? Na kii ah sathau thundim inla, kuan in. Bethlehem mi Jesse kiang ah ka hon sawl ding. Atapate lak a mi kumpipa ding in ka sep khinta hi," achi hi.
heading: David Kumpipa Dia Thaunilh Ahi

paite: Samuel in, "Bangchi in ka kuan thei dia? Saul in ana zaleh hon that ding," achi hi. TOUPA'N, "Bawngla hon pi inla, TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia hong ka hi," chi in.
"Kithoihna ah Jesse sam inla, na hih ding ka hon hilh ding. Amin ka hon hilh dingpa sathau hon nilhsak in," achi hi.
Samuel in TOUPA gen bang in ahih a, Bethlehem ah ahohta hi. Khua a upate'n ling kawm in amah ana dawn ua, "Hoih lam thu a hong na hi maw?" achi uh. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu ah hi e,” achi hi.
"TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia hong ka hi. Kisiangsak unla kithoihna ah hong pai sam un," achi hi. Jesse leh atapate asiangsak a, kithoihna ah asam hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ahong pai un Eliab ana en a, "TOUPA sathau nilhpa ama a ompa ahi mahmah ve," achi hi.

Himahleh ToUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Amel in hiam, asandan hiam in en ke'n. Ke'n amah ka deih kei hi. TOUPA'N mihing et bang in a-en kei. Mihing in polam a kilatdan a-en a, TOUPA'N bel lungtang a-en zaw hi,” achi hi.
Jesse in Abinadab asam a, Samuel ma ah apaisak hi. Ama'n, "Hiai leng TOUPA tel ahi nai kei,” achi hi.
Jesse in Shammah ava paisak nawn hi. Ama'n, "Hiai leng TOUPA tel ahi nai kei lai," achi hi.
Huchi in Jesse in atapa sagihte Samuel ma ah apaisak nawn hi. Samuel in Jesse kiang ah, "TOUPA'N hiaite atel kei," achi hi.

Samuel in Jesse kiang ah, "Hiai ah na tapate a-om kim vek uhia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Anaupangpen a-om lai, ngai in, ama'n belam aching hi," achi hi. Samuel in Jesse kiang ah, "Va samsak dih ve; ahong tun masiah i tu kei ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in ava samsak a, amah ahon pi uhi. Amah bel san thiuhtheuh, mit hah kilawm leh melhoihtak ahi. "TOUPA'N, thou inla, sathau nilh in, hiai amah ahi,” achi hi.
Samuel in sathau bawm kii ala a, a-unaute lak ah amah sathau anilh hi. TOUPA Kha huai ni a pan nakpitak in David tung ah ahong tungta. Samuel athou a, Ramah ah apaita hi.
Himahleh, TOUPA Kha in Saul apawtsan a, TOUPA sawl kha gilou in amah ahihbuai hi.
heading: Kumpi Saul Inn Ah David

paite: Saul sikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, Pathian sawl kha gilou in nang hon hihbuai hi.
Ka toupa un na ma a om na sikhate kaihging tumsiamtak mi zon thu hon pe dih ve. Pathian sawl kha gilou in ahon mat chiang in atum dia, na hoih mai ding," achi uhi.
Saul in asikhate kiang ah, "Tumsiamtak mi hon zonsak unla, ka kiang ah hon pi un," achi hi.

Asikhate lak a khat in adawng a, akiang ah, "Ngai dih, Bethlehem mi Jesse tapa khat ka muta a, huai mi tumsiamtak, mihangsantak, kidoumi, thugen siam, melhoihtak ahi a, akiang ah TOUPA a om hi," achi hi.
Saul in Jesse kiang ah mi asawl a, "Na tapa David belamching a om ka kiang ah hon hohsak in," achi hi.
Jesse in sabiltung, tanghou leh uain thawl khat leh kelnou ala a, Saul piak ding in atapa David aposak hi.
Saul kiang ah David ava tung a, ama ah ava dingh hi. Ama'n ana it mahmah a, agalvan tawipa in apangsak hi.
Saul in Jesse kiang ah, "David ka kiang ah om hen, ka mit atung mahmah hi," chi a hilh ding in mi asawl hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul tung a Pathian sawl dawi ahong om chiang in David in kaihging ala a, atum zel hi. Huchi in Saul ahong halh a, ahoih a; dawi in apawtsan hi.
